title: Uber's layoff memo also has a work from home message for remaining 29,000 employees

Uber is ending work from home for all but 1% of employees, asking remote staff to move to an office near their team. The three-day hybrid policy stays, and Uber will enforce it, with global teams concentrated in New York and San Francisco.

title: Ontario couple donates 187-acre Wilson Island sanctuary bought in 1989

title: How WhatsApp messages led to former USCIS official in $960,000 citizenship scam

title: Ladakh LG taps 90 million litres of glacial water after village head's appeal
content: nearly 90 million litres of glacial water have started irrigating 12 villages in ladakh every day . the massive volume of glacier-melt, previously flowing untapped into the River Indus, is now being channelised into the Igoo-Phey Irrigation Canal . it was an appeal from a village chief that drove the LG to brainstorm on harnessing glaciers and snowmelt for productive use .

title: Earthquake of magnitude 5.0 hits flood-ravaged Nepal
content: the tremor was reported hours after a magnitude 5.3 earthquake struck Tibet . the quake occurred at a depth of 35 km . it comes days after another earthquake of magnitude 5.0 struck Tibet last week . floods were triggered by an ice-rock avalanche near the border .

title: Ladakh's tourist footfall continues rising; August sees most foreign visitors
content: 4,05,085 tourists visited the Union Territory in the first eight months of 2026, exceeding the 3,35,872 tourists recorded for all of 2025 . Aug 2026 saw the highest foreign tourist footfall recorded in any month so far this year .

title: BJP got Rs 1,473 crore to fight Bengal, Assam, 3 other assembly polls
content: BJP got Rs 1,473cr to fight Bengal, Assam, 3 other assembly polls . total receipts by BJP's central party headquarters stood at Rs 1472.8 crore . the party's closing balance rose to Rs 7,627.2 crore upon the completion of elections on may 6, 2026 .

title: Delhi HC raps Centre for outing survivor's name in its POSH handbook
content: posh handbook was published on preventing such harassment and dealing with complaints . HC asked union govt's lawyer to come back with names of officials "responsible for this content" he submitted that the matter has since been settled and therefore sought directions for removal .

title: UK-Israel spat gets ugly: Tel Aviv to close British consulate in Jerusalem
content: the move comes in retaliation for London’s sanctions on Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank . the consulate is accredited to the Palestinian Authority in the west bank . he also announced that Britain would no longer be allowed to participate in the US-led coordination mission for Gaza .

title: Holy Grail of AI or hype? What OpenAI's GPT‑6 Astra can do, and what it can't
content: astra is the "world's most intelligent and aligned model," openAI says . the company says Astra scored 99.9% on ARC-AGI-3, 98% on FrontierMath Tier 4 and 100% on ExploitBench .

title: Building collapses to fires, 33k died in 5 years from 2020
content: between 2020 and 2024, nearly 33,000 people died across the country in incidents involving building collapses, fires and falls into pits and manholes . most of these deaths occurred in urban areas, pointing to serious gaps in civic governance and enforcement of safety regulations .

title: UPI-ng the ante: PM Modi wants desi connect with global pay
content: PM Narendra Modi calls for India to set its own standards and protocols for cross-border payments and directly integrate its payment system with countries where Indian diaspora populations are large . he said the move could also reduce the cost of remittances, noting that Indians abroad send the largest volume of money home globally .

title: Putin meeting PM Modi on Friday; energy, defence high on agenda
content: putin is travelling to india this week for his first overseas participation in a BRICS summit since the Russia-Ukraine war started in febr 2022 . a Kremlin spokesperson said India’s energy imports from Russia were setting new records and both countries had similar positions on the war .

title: Watch: US strikes 5 Iranian oil tankers near Kharg after IRGC targeted navy warships
content: the attack came after the IRGC targeted a US navy warship with ballistic missiles twice over the past two days . no US personnel were injured, the US military said . the attack comes after a military warship evaded both Iranian missile attacks .
